options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

verdict.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
verdict.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
verdict.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor

conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.

options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. New bathroom floor finishes may be laid over the existing ones using adhesive, also during the 3-year restriction. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: any time, including the first 3 years
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap

conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Pre-packed waterproofing screed and waterproofing membrane before the new finishes
Pending verification: Membrane upturned at least 150mm against walls, kerbs and pipes
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Water test after replacing the floor finishes

routes.reason: Confirm the block completion date before replacing bathroom finishes. Replacing bathroom/toilet wall finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit.

conditions: Pending verification: No tampering with existing structures
Pending verification: Total thickness of wall finishes including plaster at most 25mm

routes.reason: Confirm the block completion date before replacing bathroom finishes. Bathroom/toilet wall and floor finishes in a newly built block cannot be removed or replaced for 3 years from the block's completion date (protects the waterproofing membrane).
routes.route: Replace: block completed less than 3 years ago
routes.alternative: Overlay new floor finishes on the existing ones with adhesive (see HDB-BATH-3YR-OVERLAY).

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

verdict.reason: Hacking or removing structural members (RC walls, columns, beams, slabs, maisonette staircases) is not allowed, nor is a new entrance through an RC wall.
verdict.route: Demolish: the wall is structural (RC wall, column, beam, slab) or the change cuts a new doorway through an RC wall
verdict.alternative: Keep the RC wall; change only non-structural partitions (with a permit).

options.reason: Pending: identify the partition material; HDB prohibits combustible or toxic-emission materials such as plywood. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Erect: building a new partition (63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum)
conditions: Pending verification: Adequate natural lighting and ventilation if it creates a habitable room
Pending verification: Fire escape route direct, not through another room
Pending verification: RC lintol over any opening in a hollow block wall
Pending verification: Only one layer of 63mm hollow block or 80mm glass block
Pending verification: Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration
Pending verification: No partitions of combustible or toxic-emission materials (e.g. plywood, plastics, asbestos)

options.reason: Confirm a non-structural wall with HDB before using this demolition route.
options.route: Demolish: demolishing or altering a non-structural partition wall (hollow block/brick, drywall, Ferrolite) or non-load-bearing RC element
conditions: Pending verification: Existing RC structures must not be tampered with
Pending verification: Demolition only up to the underside of the RC beam/slab
Pending verification: Brick/block walls demolished top down; drywall/Ferrolite in full, joint to joint
Pending verification: Stop and inform HDB immediately if steel bars are found
Pending verification: Non-load-bearing RC elements: a Professional Engineer (Civil/Structural) must supervise
Pending verification: Noisy works only Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, at most 3 consecutive days

routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.

conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor

suggestions.verdict_reason: Choose the renovation method; the requested work has not been cleared.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.

conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: Pending verification: Adequate natural lighting and ventilation if it creates a habitable room

Pending verification: Only one layer of 63mm hollow block or 80mm glass block
Pending verification: Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration
Pending verification: No partitions of combustible or toxic-emission materials (e.g. plywood, plastics, asbestos)

options.reason: Confirm a non-structural wall with HDB before using this demolition route.
options.route: Demolish: demolishing or altering a non-structural partition wall (hollow block/brick, drywall, Ferrolite) or non-load-bearing RC element
conditions: Pending verification: Existing RC structures must not be tampered with

Pending verification: Brick/block walls demolished top down; drywall/Ferrolite in full, joint to joint
Pending verification: Stop and inform HDB immediately if steel bars are found

Pending verification: Noisy works only Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, at most 3 consecutive days

suggestions.title: Raise the floor level by 100mm with concrete
suggestions.reason: Requested by the board

verdict.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
verdict.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
verdict.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.

Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.

conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar

routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.

conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.

Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.

conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar

Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.

conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
Pending verification: New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap
Pending verification: No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

verdict.alternative: Keep the RC wall; change only non-structural partitions (with a permit).

options.reason: Pending: identify the partition material; HDB prohibits combustible or toxic-emission materials such as plywood. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
options.route: Erect: building a new partition (63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum)
conditions: Pending verification: Adequate natural lighting and ventilation if it creates a habitable room

Pending verification: Only one layer of 63mm hollow block or 80mm glass block
Pending verification: Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration
Pending verification: No partitions of combustible or toxic-emission materials (e.g. plywood, plastics, asbestos)

options.reason: Confirm a non-structural wall with HDB before using this demolition route.
options.route: Demolish: demolishing or altering a non-structural partition wall (hollow block/brick, drywall, Ferrolite) or non-load-bearing RC element
conditions: Pending verification: Existing RC structures must not be tampered with

Pending verification: Brick/block walls demolished top down; drywall/Ferrolite in full, joint to joint
Pending verification: Stop and inform HDB immediately if steel bars are found
Pending verification: Non-load-bearing RC elements: a Professional Engineer (Civil/Structural) must supervise
Pending verification: Noisy works only Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, at most 3 consecutive days
